A portable one-voxel stress integration scenario passes JVM and JS.

The original-equation/scientific audit finds material distant-reference correction and HRF-tail errors; certification remains unavailable. Full declared B0/stress requests are now attempted with explicit 120-second cancellation limits, retaining partial attempted counters and distinguishing discarded-block work from emitted output. Final repaired B0 reaches only 404/100000 attempts in 122.274 seconds; N=1200 reaches 32/10000 in 147.754 seconds. No complete certified throughput or measured engine-memory result is claimed.

Fixed production DatasetAcquisitionDomain's O(V^2) reverse-map setup by reusing one ordinal array; fixed diagnostic reader allocations. B0 setup is now under two seconds in the final repeats. Finite-state remains deferred: no complete original-family-qualified B0 decision, no silent replacement of the frozen baseline by the 901-request diagnostic budget. Next work is bounded observation/reference error admission, broader scientific evidence, then complete resource qualification.

Final gates: dataset 76 JVM / 62 JS; targeted workflows 8 JVM / 8 JS; compiler warning-clean. Existing main-discovery warning only. No hosted CI, publication or epic closure.
